messages:
maria: Heads up — since the autoscaler rollout yesterday we're seeing ~30 pods Pending that request nvidia.com/gpu in us-west-2. Events say 0/1 nodes available: node(s) didn't match node taints. Anyone else seeing this?

kevin: yep same. autoscaler spun up nodes but pods still stuck Pending. dashboard shows new nodes have taint gpu-only=true:NoSchedule.

sara: quick question — are the pod specs supposed to tolerate that taint? might be a chart change that removed tolerations during the rollout. can you paste `kubectl describe pod <some-pending-pod>` or `kubectl get nodes --show-labels`?

maria: `kubectl describe pod gpu-trainer-5f7d` -> Events: FailedScheduling: 0/4 nodes are available: 4 node(s) didn't match node taints.

ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up nodegroup gw-gpu-usw2-nd by 3 (instanceType: g4dn.xlarge). node taint applied: `gpu-only=true:NoSchedule` per nodegroup config.

kevin: looks like the nodegroup was configured to taint nodes to isolate GPU workload. but many pods (batch jobs + some dev pods) no longer include tolerations in latest helm values. that explains mismatch.

sara: short-term fix: add toleration to the job pod spec. example toleration snippet to paste into charts: 

```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "gpu-only"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```

sara: if pods are batch/ephemeral and on preemptible/spot nodes, consider adding `tolerationSeconds` to allow NodeTerminated events to evict gracefully: 

```yaml
  - key: "spot-instance"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoExecute"
    tolerationSeconds: 120
```

maria: thanks — any guidance on nodeAffinity? we currently have some pods with nodeSelector `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool: gpu-pool` but others rely on label `instance-type: g4dn`. cluster autoscaler created nodes with label `node.kubernetes.io/gpu: true` instead.

kevin: prefer nodeAffinity over nodeSelector for flexibility. example: 

```yaml
affinity:
  nodeAffinity:
    requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: "node.kubernetes.io/gpu"
          operator: In
          values: ["true"]
```

kevin: combine tolerations + nodeAffinity. toleration ensures schedule to tainted nodes, affinity ensures correct pool.

ops-bot: note: autoscaler config for gw-gpu-usw2-nd currently sets taint `gpu-only=true` and label `node.kubernetes.io/gpu=true`. nodegroup scaling limits: min=0 max=10.

sara: longer-term we should standardize on a single taint key and document it in infra/README. mixing `gpu-only` and `dedicated=gpu` across clusters causes exactly this. I'll open a small RFC. also add a presubmit check to catch missing tolerations in helm charts.

kevin: also watch cost — autoscaler reacted and brought up 3 gpus, but because pods didn't tolerate taints we had wasted nodes for ~45m. suggest setting node group `scaleDownDelay` + tighter pod-eviction heuristics or set a small `buffer` via cluster-autoscaler config to avoid bounce.

maria: temporary mitigation: I'm patching the most critical jobs to include tolerations and nodeAffinity, then will roll a chart change for the training repo.

sara: ping me when done, I'll follow with RFC + presubmit. :thumbsup:

kevin: commands used to inspect: `kubectl get nodes -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,TAINTS:.spec.taints` and `kubectl describe pod <pod>` — saved me.

maria: done — patched jobs, some pending pods scheduled now. will monitor for evictions on spot nodes. thanks all.
